{"metadata":{"description":"Migrate Codex CLI conversations / MCP servers / memories into DeepSeek Harness ｜ 把 Codex CLI 的对话、MCP、记忆迁移到 DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1335057756","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-codex-migrate","slug":"polarskicpl/dsh-codex-migrate","topics":["codex","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","mcp","migration","model-context-protocol"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Migrate Codex CLI conversations / MCP servers / memories into DeepSeek Harness ｜ 把 Codex CLI 的对话、MCP"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"、记忆迁移到 DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-codex-migrate"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Predictable one-way structured migration between Codex and DeepSeek Harness
English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Version 2.0 turns the plugin into a two-sided migration bridge. Import Codex tasks into DSH, or move"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" one DSH conversation—or every active conversation in a project—into Codex. Every action is an expli"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"cit one-time import; the source conversation is never modified later by background synchronization."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## v2.0.4 compatibility update"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-codex-migrate@2.0.4` carries the compatibility fixes introduced in v2.0.3 and is verified with "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"the public npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` (`latest` as checked on 2026-09-23). Those fixes addres"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s DSH's newer session persistence and Web client modules:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Codex → DSH:** write valid Session V3 events through the lifecycle-scoped `SessionHandle` API, i"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ncluding flush/close, with a fallback for older persistence services.
- **DSH Web UI:** update the c"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"lient injection graph, use the active conversation's session ID for “Continue in Codex,” and keep la"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rge-history scans responsive with bounded metadata reads and asynchronous transcript reads.
- **DSH "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"→ Codex:** open the imported task through the host operating system when a browser blocks `codex://`"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" navigation, while retaining browser navigation as a fallback."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The npm `next` and `alpha` DSH channels are not claimed as supported by this release. See the change"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"log for the release history."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What's new in v2.0"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Two-way one-shot imports:** Codex → DSH and DSH → Codex both convert history into the target's s"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"tructured conversation format instead of flattening everything into plain text.
- **Continue in Code"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"x:** a native Codex action below DSH assistant replies imports the current conversation and opens th"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"e new Codex task.
- **Continue in DSH:** the bundled MCP server and `continue-in-dsh` Skill let a Co"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"dex user say “Continue in DSH” to import and open the current task in DSH.
- **Batch migration by pr"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"oject:** import every unarchived conversation in a DSH project in one operation while preserving the"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" original workspace path.
- **Project-less Codex tasks:** conversations without a Codex project are "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"imported into the canonical `(no project)` / `codex-unprojected` workspace.
- **MCP memory Beta:** `"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"remember_memory`, `search_memory`, and `forget_memory` provide local persistent memories with global"},{"id":"p10s10","text":", project, and conversation scopes.
- **Three memory sources:** independently import Codex Markdown "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"memory, bridge MCP memory, and Memory Skill storage.
- **Faster inventory refreshes:** an incrementa"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"l cache reparses only new or changed files and isolates corrupted sessions.
- **Refined UI:** simpli"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"fied cards and lists, fixed live language switching, and consistent actions, badges, spacing, and da"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"sts, fixed live language switching, and consistent actions, badges, spacing, and dark/light styling."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Entry points"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The Codex icon appears beside DSH's native copy and feedback actions:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Select the **Codex icon** to import one DSH conversation and navigate to Codex.
- Open **Settings "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"→ Codex Migration → Batch Migration by Project** to import every unarchived conversation in a projec"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"t.
- Say **“Continue in DSH”** in Codex to import the current Codex task and navigate to DSH."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> Version 2.0 intentionally does not provide shared conversations, background bidirectional sync, co"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"nflict merging, or a Codex inline monitor. Each import is inspectable, repeatable, and cannot silent"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ly rewrite the same history on both sides."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation: configure both sides"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The complete experience has two local components:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Component | Installed in | Purpose |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `dsh-codex-migrate` | DSH | Reads, converts, and creates DSH/Codex conversations; hosts the loopba"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ck-only handoff service |
| `dsh-codex-bridge` MCP + Skill | Codex | Provides “Continue in DSH,” MCP"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" memory tools, and the trigger workflow |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The DSH plugin alone supports settings-page imports and DSH → Codex actions. Install the Codex compa"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nion as well to start imports from Codex or use MCP memory."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- A working DeepSeek Harness installation.
- Codex desktop, Codex CLI, or the Codex IDE extension.
-"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" `node` available in the terminal; Node.js 18 or newer is recommended.
- Commands below use the DSH "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"`web` profile. Replace `web` if you use another profile."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Step 1: install the DSH plugin"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"First installation:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Upgrade from an earlier version:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Codex Migration**. You should see **Imported Conversations**, **"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"Batch Migration by Project**, and **Memory Import**."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Step 2: get the Codex companion"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The MCP server and Skill are bundled in this repository, so keep the cloned directory available loca"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"MCP server and Skill are bundled in this repository, so keep the cloned directory available locally:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"If you already cloned the repository, update it with `git pull`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Step 3: register the MCP server in Codex"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Windows PowerShell:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"macOS / Linux:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"If the same MCP name is already registered with an old path, run this first and then repeat the add "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ame MCP name is already registered with an old path, run this first and then repeat the add command:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Verify the registration:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Codex also supports direct `~/.codex/config.toml` configuration, but the CLI avoids path and TOML es"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"caping mistakes. See the official Codex MCP documentation."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"### Step 4: install the `continue-in-dsh` Skill"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"Windows PowerShell:"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"macOS / Linux:"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"## Security boundary"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"- The DSH handoff service binds only to `127.0.0.1`.
- Mutations require a generated installation to"},{"id":"p49s2","text":"ken; the token is never stored in this repository.
- Disabling the DSH plugin also stops the handoff"},{"id":"p49s3","text":" service.
- MCP memory stays local and does not automatically send raw project files or complete con"},{"id":"p49s4","text":"versations to third-party services.
- The plugin writes only to the configured `outputDir`, DSH sess"},{"id":"p49s5","text":"ion storage, and the local MCP memory file."}],"truncated":true}
